notes.title: Big Bug Fix 01/12018
notes.content:
New day, new bugs fixed :D

- Fix: Enemies no more fly away if you touch them in certain ways
- Fix: Hunters now stops while attacking
- Fix: Tree frog and hunters won't attack you like Bastion (pew pew) (added delay to attack)

notes.title: Bug Fix 27/11/2018
notes.content:
New round of bug fixing and tweaking:

- Addition: Levers now have sounds
- Addition: Visual input on movable objects

- Fix: Misalignement of skip text in cutscene on big resolutions

We are aware of a bug that won't let you walk at normal speed on mooving platforms. We will fix that as soon as we can.

notes.title: Bug Fix 24/11/2018
notes.content:
We are aware of bugs and glitches and we are solving them.
This is the changelog of the ones we solved:

- Completely removed mouse input.
- Fixed a badly located teleport leading to an infinite fall in the High Tree level.
- Fix: unable to go back to menu from map view.
- Tweaked enemies knockbacks.
- Addition: Cutscenes are now skippable.
- Fix: Shooting traps now do damage (it was too good to be real).
- Fixed a case where fire won't kill you.
- Fix: Enemies don't fly anymore.
- Fix: mapping errors leading to an impossible to finish level in High Tree.
- Fix: level texture misalignement.

If you find new bugs or glitches let us now in the comments section.
